id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e30: "The handsome blue-haired man at the gate kept gazing at the sea, I think from sorrow hidden in his heart.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e41: "The handsome blue-haired man at the gate seems to have vanished. What a shame I can't see him again.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e52: "You were ogling the tavern bunny girl again and drank too much, didn't you! You never learn!

id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e60: "Why did I marry this man? If I'd marry anyway, I should've chosen that handsome man at the gate.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e71: "Going outside raises plague risk, so we shelter at the church. Good thing the priest is a fine person.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e86: "That young man who just left the church. He's shadowy and handsome. He'd surely look beautiful as a gold statue.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e92: "...Oh, sorry. That's inappropriate. Don't mind me.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e9f: "Confusion continues, but with the Gold Plague gone we're relieved first. Thank you, truly.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3eac: "Soldiers went scouting after the golden icebergs vanished. I saw them at the southeast entrance.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ec3: "With the plague gone and Yggdrasil revived, I feel refreshed. But...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ed0: "A few days ago a prickly-looking girl was gloomy near the church. ...What's with her?

id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3eed: "If that dragon attacks the town, there'll be terrible damage. Maybe I should consider evacuating...

id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f17: "Dragons are said to be strong, and if it'd come here the damage would be big. I'm so glad it was slain...
